description: The exact total for these tyres and options, line by line, exactly what the payment page will charge. Checks stock and fitting capacity. Does not order, reserve, email or charge anything.

delivery.description: pickup = collect at the workshop in Haarlem (free); delivery = shipped to an address in the Netherlands (fee from get_shop_info).

fitting.description: Optional: fitting and balancing at the workshop (pickup only), on a day from list_fitting_days.

items.description: Tyres to order: the slug from search_tyres and how many. At most 4 products and 8 tyres per order.

locale.description: Language of the payment page, the order page and the emails. Default nl.

tpms.description: With fitting only: the car has tyre pressure sensors (TPMS). Adds the sensor surcharge.
